description.en: The photo shows former US President Barack Obama seen from a profile view interacting with young children looking out of a window. Several toddlers and young children of diverse ethnic backgrounds lean over the windowsill as Obama smiles up at them with his hand placed on the exterior wall near the window.
description.tr: Fotoğrafta, eski ABD Başkanı Barack Obama profil açısıyla bir pencereden bakan küçük çocuklarla etkileşim halinde görülüyor. Açık pencerenin eşiğine tutunan farklı etnik kökenlerden birkaç bebek ve çocuk içeriye bakarken, Obama elini pencere pervazına koymuş şekilde gülümsüyor.

authenticity.rationale: The image appears to be a genuine photo of Barack Obama greeting children at a window, showing natural lighting, realistic hand anatomy, and cohesive depth of field with no visible signs of AI generation or digital manipulation.

context.rationale: The image accurately shows former US President Barack Obama smiling up at young children of diverse ethnic backgrounds looking out of a window during a 2011 visit to a day care center in Bethesda, Maryland, which he subsequently posted on social media in August 2017.

summary.en: The image accurately shows former US President Barack Obama smiling at young children of diverse ethnic backgrounds looking out of a window. It was taken during a 2011 visit to a day care center in Bethesda, Maryland, and later posted by Obama in August 2017.
